India in Dialogue with IOC for 2036 Olympics Bid

The International Olympic Committee (IOC) has confirmed that India is among seven nations engaged in continuous dialogue regarding a potential bid to host the 2036 Olympic Games. Qatar is also part of this group. These nations have been invited to present their bids to the IOC.
